manage_instances_unauthorized: Managing tagmas here requires an access token.
manage_instances_forbidden: This session is not allowed to manage tagmas.
manage_instances_unreachable: Cannot reach the local tagma host on this machine.
manage_instances_host_forbidden: This host is not allowed to manage tagmas.
manage_instances_session_required: Sign in as the platform administrator to manage tagmas.
manage_instances_stop_description: Stop the tagma process "{slug}"? Its state is kept on disk.
manage_instances_error_slug_taken: That slug is already in use.
manage_instances_error_workspace_overlap: That workspace already belongs to a tagma process.
manage_instances_error_spawn_timeout: The tagma process did not start in time; check its logs.
manage_instances_error_not_found: That tagma process no longer exists.
manage_instances_error_not_running: That tagma process is not running.
manage_instances_error_internal: The tagma host hit an internal error.
manage_instances_create_failed: The tagma could not be started; the enrollment code stays valid on the card above.
manage_instances_create_mint_failed: The enrollment code could not be minted; try again.
manage_instances_dialog_desc: Create a tagma in the cloud or connect a local one.
manage_instances_method_cloud_desc: Provision and enroll automatically on this deployment.
manage_instances_method_local_desc: Mint an enrollment code for a self-run tagma.
manage_instances_mint_done_hint: Give this code to your tagma (KALLIP_TAGMA_RELAY_ENROLLMENT_CODE). It shows once here; the pending row below keeps its masked form.
manage_instances_create_provider_locked_: Encrypted keys unlock only in a passkey session on this device.
manage_instances_push_not_applied: Provider key stored on "{slug}" but no agent picked it up yet — use Apply on its profiles page.
manage_instances_push_verified: Provider key delivered to "{slug}" and connect-checked.
manage_instances_push_unverified: Provider key delivered to "{slug}", but the connect check failed — see its profiles page.
manage_instances_push_unreachable: "{slug}" did not become reachable in time; nothing was pushed. Add the key on its profiles page.
